book.universe.probe_log.page.1:
UNV-7 SURVEY PROBE LOG

Main engine failure. Forced landing on this planet. Hull breached, primary systems offline.

To whoever finds this: the gear aboard can still be repaired.
book.universe.probe_log.page.2:
[MULTITOOL]
Damaged in the impact. Two copper ingots, two redstone and an iron ingot will fix it.

Hold USE: mining laser. It overheats if fired too long.
Sneak + USE: scan for nearby ore veins.
book.universe.probe_log.page.3:
[EXOSUIT]
Helmet and chestplate seal in your oxygen; the full set holds off cold, heat, toxins and radiation.

Oxygen capsules: bottled leaves.
Hazard cells: copper, redstone, coal.

Jetpack: jump again in mid-air.
book.universe.probe_log.page.4:
[SHIPS]
Build one from blocks: a helm, thrusters, fuel tanks; dress the hull as you like. Use the helm to assemble.

Fill the tanks with launch fuel (coal, gunpowder, a glass bottle).
Climb past the sky to reach space.
book.universe.probe_log.page.5:
[COURSE]
This planet has a moon: airless and cold, but rich in titanium.

In space the impulse engine gets you there fast. Fly into a body's atmosphere to land.

Better equipment needs titanium.
book.universe.probe_log.page.6:
[MISSION]
This probe belongs to the Universe Survey Programme.
All other probes have gone silent.

More worlds in this system await mapping.

— END OF LOG —
book.universe.probe_log.title: Probe Log

guide.universe.dyson.editor:
Press Y for the Dyson sphere editor, or open it from an ejector, silo or receiver.

Swarm: up to 20 orbits
Shell: up to 10 layers; pick a grid (geodesic, honeycomb, lat-long), build nodes and frames, then shells
Latitude: within 30 degrees at first; Dyson Stress I and II raise it to 60 and 90
Material: each built node pulls 10 sails a minute from the swarm
guide.universe.dyson.editor.title: Dyson Sphere Editor
guide.universe.dyson.receiver:
Ray receivers bring the sphere's power down. Full efficiency after 20 min of steady reception; 2 min off resets it.

Power mode: 6 to 15 kW
Photon mode: critical photons, 6/min max
Graviton lens: doubles power, one per 10 min
guide.universe.dyson.receiver.title: Ray Receiver
guide.universe.dyson.rockets:
Nodes and frames are built with rockets from a vertical launching silo.

Rate: one rocket every 12 s
Needs: open sky
Power: 18 kW
Rocket: lands in 20 s, +1 structure point
Per structure point: 96 W
guide.universe.dyson.rockets.title: Rockets
guide.universe.dyson.sails:
The EM-Rail Ejector fires solar sails into the swarm; pick the orbit in its screen.

Rate: one sail every 3 s
Needs: star 5° above horizon, or in space
Lifetime: 90 min
Per sail: 36 W x star luminosity factor
guide.universe.dyson.sails.title: Solar Sails
guide.universe.endgame.antimatter:
The miniature particle collider turns critical photons into antimatter.

Power: 12 kW
Research: Dirac Inversion Mechanism

Antimatter goes into universe matrices and fuel rods. 12 antimatter, 12 hydrogen, a constraint sphere and a titanium alloy make 2 rods.
guide.universe.endgame.antimatter.title: Antimatter
guide.universe.endgame.finale:
Mission Complete is the last tech: 1,000 points of white matrices only.
Finishing it plays the ending. The game carries on afterwards and upgrades stay open.
Replay the ending from the Ending chapter.
guide.universe.endgame.finale.title: Mission Complete
guide.universe.endgame.power:
Mini Fusion Power Plant
15 kW from deuteron fuel rods, 6 min per rod at full load

Artificial Star
72 kW from antimatter fuel rods, 15 min per rod at full load
guide.universe.endgame.power.title: Fusion and Artificial Stars
guide.universe.endgame.white:
Universe matrices (white) fund Mission Complete and the four uncapped upgrade lines.

Universe matrix: composite + information + gravity + antimatter
Composite matrix: blue + red + yellow
guide.universe.endgame.white.title: Universe Matrix
guide.universe.ending.done: Press the button below to replay the ending and this world's statistics.
guide.universe.ending.locked: Finish Mission Complete to replay the ending here.
guide.universe.exploration.bases:
Place a base beacon to register a base; right-click to rename. No research.

Teleporters reach your bases and stations you've visited.
Cost: 12 kJ per jump, 10 s to recharge
Range: stand within 6 blocks
Pets within 24 blocks come along
Research: Teleport Network
guide.universe.exploration.bases.title: Bases and Teleporters
guide.universe.exploration.discoveries:
Press K for the discovery log. Systems are logged when you enter space, planets when you land.
Discoverers can rename them, up to 24 characters.

New system: 5 to 20 survey data (black holes the most)
New planet: 3 or 4

Survey data goes into hand-in research (Interstellar Survey, Technology Modules, Warp Calibration) and grade C modules, and it sells.
guide.universe.exploration.poi:
Scans mark nearby points of interest.

Drop pod: repair to expand your exosuit
Monolith: 3 survey data the first time
Tech cache: break it for a module
Signal booster: finds one within 2,000 blocks
guide.universe.exploration.poi.title: Points of Interest
guide.universe.exploration.visor:
The analysis visor identifies creatures, plants, ores, stars and planets. Hold the multitool, press V, aim and hold right-click for 1.2 s.
On creatures it also shows diet, produce and whether you can ride them.

First discoverer gets survey data:
Creature: 2
Plant, tree, mineral: 1
Whole planet's wildlife: +5
guide.universe.exploration.visor.title: Analysis Visor
guide.universe.gathering.fluids:
Oil Extractor
Two blocks tall, lower half on a crude oil seep. 0.5 to 1.5 crude oil per second, slowing as it drains, down to 30%. Power 840 W.

Water Pump
Sits on a water source. 50 water a minute for 300 W. Not on acid-ocean planets.
guide.universe.gathering.fluids.title: Oil and Water
guide.universe.gathering.mining:
The mining machine mines ore below it and outputs from its front. With several ores in range it mines only the most common one.

Area: 5x5, 3 layers deep
Rate: 1 item per ore block every 40 s
Power: 420 W
Research: Electromagnetism
guide.universe.gathering.mining.title: Mining Machine
guide.universe.gathering.smelting:
The arc smelter smelts with electricity and has three input slots: ingots, steel, graphite, silicon, titanium and glass.
Sorters feeding it only insert what the recipe needs.

Power: 360 W
Raw ore to ingot: 1 s
3 iron ingots to steel: 3 s (Steel Smelting)
guide.universe.gathering.smelting.title: Arc Smelter
guide.universe.gathering.veins:
Each ore block holds a set amount and turns back into stone when empty.

Reserve: 400 to 1200, times planet abundance 0.5 to 1.5
Overworld: surface outcrops of iron, copper and coal, some gold and crude oil seeps
Other planets: titanium, silicon, sulfur, fire ice, optical crystal, uranium and more, by planet type

A multitool scan finds veins fastest.
guide.universe.gathering.veins.title: Ore Veins
guide.universe.husbandry.exocraft:
A drivable mining vehicle. Use it on the ground to deploy; three pickaxe hits pack it up with its fuel and cargo.

Right-click to get in, sneak to get out
W / S: throttle, A / D: steer
Hold left-click: mining laser, 12 blocks
Vein scan: multitool right-click, 64 blocks

Tank: 1,000 (ship fuel), hold: 27 slots
guide.universe.husbandry.exocraft.title: Exocraft
guide.universe.husbandry.produce:
Tamed creatures produce items, follow you, and the big ones can be ridden.

Produce: feed when hungry, drops after 30 s, hungry again after 5 min
Follow: from 10 blocks, teleports past 12
Sneak + empty hand: follow / stay
Riding: large quadrupeds, hexapods and bipeds; right-click with an empty hand, hold jump to charge
guide.universe.husbandry.produce.title: Produce and Riding
guide.universe.husbandry.taming:
The visor shows what a creature eats. Feed it once a second; each bite may tame it.

Herbivores: wheat, carrots, apples, feed
Carnivores: raw meat, carnivore feed
Chance: docile 35%, skittish 25%, territorial 15%, predator 8%
guide.universe.husbandry.taming.title: Taming
guide.universe.logistics.assembler:
Assemblers craft the recipe picked in their screen. Each slot takes only its own ingredient, and automation fills up to 4 crafts.

Mk.I: speed 0.75, 260 W
Mk.II: speed 1.0, 540 W
Mk.III: speed 1.5, 1.08 kW
guide.universe.logistics.assembler.title: Assemblers
guide.universe.logistics.belts:
Belts carry items the way you faced when placing them. Mobs and dropped items ride along.

Sneak + empty hand: flat, up, down
Empty hand: take items off
Speed: 6, 12 or 30 items/s by tier
guide.universe.logistics.belts.title: Conveyor Belts
guide.universe.logistics.blueprint:
Blueprints copy builds with recipes, filters and station settings.

Blank: mark two corners (32 max per side), sneak + right-click to save
Saved: right-click to build, R rotates, sneak + right-click clears
Range: 64 blocks
Materials come from inventory and cargo; right-click again to fill gaps.
guide.universe.logistics.blueprint.title: Blueprints
guide.universe.logistics.sorters:
Sorters move items from the block behind to the block in front, only what fits.

Right-click with item: set filter
Empty hand: clear filter
Speed: 1.5, 3 or 6 moves/s
Splitters alternate between outputs. Storage Mk.I has 30 slots.
guide.universe.logistics.sorters.title: Sorters
guide.universe.logistics.stations:
Stations send and receive by each slot's settings. Drones serve one dimension; vessels travel between planets.
Set each slot's item and limit, then storage, supply or demand for local and remote. Stations charge only from grid surplus.

Planetary: 4 slots x 5,000, drone range 1,000 by default
Interstellar: 5 slots x 10,000 plus vessels; other systems cost 2 space warpers a trip
guide.universe.logistics.stations.title: Logistics Stations
guide.universe.power.generators:
Wind Turbine
300 W x wind factor. Higher is windier; rain x1.2, thunder x1.5. Nothing on airless planets.

Solar Panel
360 W with open sky, scaled by sun height and star brightness. Zero at night.

Thermal Power Plant
Up to 2.16 kW from vanilla fuel, burning only what the grid draws. Coal lasts 11 s at full load.
guide.universe.power.generators.title: Generators
guide.universe.power.grid:
Tesla towers power nearby devices and link to each other into a grid. No wires.
When power runs short, accumulators discharge first, then all machines slow down evenly.

Power radius: 6 blocks
Link distance: 12 blocks
Right-click a tower to see its numbers. The stats screen (O) has a power panel.
guide.universe.power.grid.title: The Grid
guide.universe.power.storage:
Accumulators charge from surplus and discharge when generation falls short. They keep their charge when broken.

Capacity: 180 kJ
Rate: up to 2.7 kW
Research: Energy Storage
guide.universe.power.storage.title: Accumulators
guide.universe.research.hand_in:
Press J for the tech tree. Early techs take a hand-in instead of a lab. Research is shared server-wide.

Electromagnetism: 10 coils, 10 boards. Tesla tower, wind turbine, mining machine
Automatic Metallurgy: 20 iron, 10 coils. Arc smelter
Basic Assembling: 20 boards, 20 gears. Assembler
Electromagnetic Matrix: 10 boards, 10 coils. Matrix lab
guide.universe.research.hand_in.title: Hand-in Research
guide.universe.research.lab:
Matrix labs turn matrices into research points. Pick a current research in the tech tree; every 5 s a lab uses one of each required matrix for one point. Labs add up.

Power: 480 W
Automation: up to 10 per slot
Research: Electromagnetic Matrix
guide.universe.research.lab.title: Matrix Lab
guide.universe.research.matrices:
All six matrices are made in assemblers; later techs need more colors.

Blue: coil + circuit board
Red: 2 energetic graphite + 2 hydrogen
Yellow: diamond + titanium crystal
Purple: 2 processors + particle broadband
Green: graviton lens + quantum chip, makes 2
White: composite + purple + green + antimatter
guide.universe.research.matrices.title: The Six Matrices
guide.universe.research.upgrades:
The rightmost column of the tech tree holds the upgrades. Early levels use lower matrices; research continues by itself while the next level needs the same ones.

Vein Utilization: mining +10%, drain x0.94
Research Speed: +25%
Carrier Engine: +25%
Ray Transmission: loss x0.85
Carrier Capacity: +10%
Solar Sail Life: +15 min
(all per level)

The first four end in white-matrix levels with no cap; capacity and sail life have 6 levels each.
guide.universe.research.upgrades.title: Upgrades
guide.universe.ship.build:
Ships are built from blocks. Right-click the helm to assemble everything connected to it; terrain is left out.

Required: one helm (its facing is the bow), at least one thruster
Optional: fuel tanks, impulse engines, warp drives, shields, weapons, seats, hull plating
Limit: 4,096 blocks
Lift-off: thrust-to-weight above 1; one thruster lifts 12 t at 1 g
guide.universe.ship.build.title: Building a Ship
guide.universe.ship.fly:
Right-click a fuel tank with fuel, then assemble at the helm; you start in the pilot seat.

WASD: thrust and turn
Space / Sneak: up / down
Sprint: impulse engine (space only)
Left-click: fire, G: switch weapon
Hold Sneak 1 s after landing: park as blocks

To space: 48 blocks above the world's top
To land: fly into a planet's atmosphere
Fuel: coal 200, coal block 1,800, launch fuel 1,000
The cabin has air and refills protection.
guide.universe.ship.fly.title: Flying
guide.universe.ship.warp:
Press M for the star map, pick a system and press Warp.

Needs: piloting in space, a warp drive aboard, a space warper in your inventory
Position: 1,200 blocks from the star, 150 from any atmosphere
Charge: 3.5 s, uses 1 warper
Range: 5 ly, +5 per warp drive (+10 for Mk.II), up to 4 drives

Space warpers come from assemblers or station shops.
guide.universe.ship.warp.title: Warping
guide.universe.start.crash:
The crash site is 60 to 110 blocks from spawn and appears the first time the world loads. Chat tells you which way the smoke is.

The chest holds:
Damaged multitool
Probe log and this guide
Copper, iron and redstone
2 oxygen capsules, 2 hazard cells
guide.universe.start.crash.title: The Crash Site
guide.universe.start.laser:
The multitool also carries a mining laser, a scanner and a plasma gun.

Hold right-click: mining laser
Sneak + right-click: scan
G: switch mining and combat mode

Laser: 10 blocks, 1.5x dig speed
Overheat: after 4 s, cools for 2 s
Scan: veins 32, points of interest 200, 5 s cooldown
Plasma bolt: 5 damage

Lasering on planets draws Sentinels.
guide.universe.start.laser.title: Laser and Scanner
guide.universe.start.multitool:
The multitool is your main early tool: pickaxe, shovel and axe in one. Repair the damaged one with copper, redstone and iron; the crash chest has exactly enough.
Without a crash site, craft one from scratch with a diamond.

Mining tier: iron
Dig speed: 6
guide.universe.start.multitool.title: The Multitool
guide.universe.start.suit:
All four pieces use iron and copper. Helmet plus chestplate seals the suit.
Fewer pieces drain faster: x2 with three, x3.5 with two, x6 with one.

Oxygen: 10 min sealed, 15 s unsealed
Hazard protection: 5 min, full set
No drain in the Overworld, stations or ships
guide.universe.start.suit.title: The Exosuit
guide.universe.survival.hazards:
Up to two hazards per planet: cold, heat, toxicity, radiation.

Full suit: 5 min, refills 25 s after
Empty: -1 HP/2 s; no oxygen -2 HP/s
Indoors x1/3, storms x2
Fire or ice blocks the opposite hazard
Capsules and cells: +50%, auto below 20%
guide.universe.survival.hazards.title: Hazards
guide.universe.survival.modules:
Press U for tech configuration to fit modules and sort cargo.

Exosuit: starts with 4 tech slots and 9 cargo; each repaired drop pod adds 1 slot and 9 cargo, up to 12 and 54
Multitool: 6 tech slots
Grades: C, B, A, S; up to three of one kind count
Sources: assemblers make C, better ones come from points of interest and stations

Jetpack: jump again in mid-air for 2.5 s of thrust, recharges in 2 s on the ground
guide.universe.survival.modules.title: Tech Modules
guide.universe.trade.missions:
Mission boards post 3 missions a day. Hold one at a time and hand it in where you took it.

Delivery: 1.6x the cargo value
Bounty: 220 per pirate
Mining: 70 per asteroid
Survey: 150 per species

Rewards scale with the station's wealth and sometimes include navigation data or a module.
guide.universe.trade.missions.title: Missions
guide.universe.trade.pirates:
Pirates can appear while you pilot in space more than 600 blocks from a station. A roll every 6 to 10 minutes, likelier with valuable cargo. 5 s after the warning, 2 to 4 fighters show up behind you.

Left-click: fire
G: photon cannon / mining beam
Escape: warp, land, reach a station or get 400 blocks away
Reward: a bounty per kill, scrap in your hold

A destroyed ship is towed to the station and each cargo stack loses 30%.
guide.universe.trade.pirates.title: Pirates
guide.universe.trade.stations:
Every system has one space station, 700 blocks outside the first landable planet. Fly in through the hangar and set down on the pad.

Trade terminal: buy and sell
Mission board: take missions
Ship repair console: 2 credits per hull point
Station teleporter: no power needed

Inside there is gravity and air. Outside you float: jump to rise, sneak to sink.
guide.universe.trade.stations.title: Space Stations
guide.universe.trade.trading:
Trade terminals are in space stations. Credits are kept on death.

Sell: click 1, Shift a stack, Ctrl all
Buy: click 1, Shift a stack

Prices drop as you sell the same thing and recover by half every 2 days.
Categories the system lacks: +30%
Local products: -25%

Every station sells warpers, fuel, thrusters and weapons; wealthy ones stock Mk.II parts.

poi.universe.log.ending.1: We leave for the landing site at dawn. I'm leaving the terminal on. Maybe the next person can use it.
poi.universe.log.ending.2: If you're reading this, take whatever is in the crates. We won't need it anymore.
poi.universe.log.ending.3: End of entry. Power at four percent.
poi.universe.log.ending.4: I've left a copy of our navigation data on this terminal. Head toward the signal.
poi.universe.log.ending.5: More tomorrow. The aurora tonight is beautiful. We all went out to watch.
poi.universe.log.ending.6: (The rest of this entry is corrupted and cannot be read.)
poi.universe.log.event.1: Three Sentinels came this afternoon. They just watched the mining rig for a while, then left.
poi.universe.log.event.2: %1$s went out to check the pipeline and hasn't come back. The beacon shows the signal stopped in the eastern valley, not moving.
poi.universe.log.event.3: A meteor came down nearby and the shockwave shattered two windows. We saved the impact coordinates to the navigation data.
poi.universe.log.event.4: Someone went through the supply crates in storage, but the lock is untouched. %1$s says we must have miscounted.
poi.universe.log.event.5: The reactor readings have started to jump. We shut down half the equipment and keep a single light on at night.
poi.universe.log.event.6: The signal booster caught a repeating transmission, not on any of our frequencies. %1$s recorded it.
poi.universe.log.event.7: Another section of ground collapsed, opening a deep shaft. %1$s dropped a glowstick in. We never heard it land.
poi.universe.log.event.8: The company finally answered: outpost decommissioned, personnel to evacuate on their own. It didn't say how.
poi.universe.log.opening.1: Outpost %1$s, day %2$s of deployment. Log entry by %3$s.
poi.universe.log.opening.3: Automatic logging restored. Outpost %1$s, day %2$s, on duty: %3$s.
poi.universe.log.opening.4: Day %2$s. Outpost %1$s. This is %3$s. If anyone finds this recording—
poi.universe.log.situation.1: The supply ship is late again. %1$s locked the last crate of oxygen capsules away and says we ration from today.
poi.universe.log.situation.2: The drill rig died in last night's storm. %1$s worked on it all night and still couldn't get it turning.
poi.universe.log.situation.3: The ore here is richer than the survey promised. %1$s says one more season and we can all retire.
poi.universe.log.situation.4: %1$s insists there is knocking under the floor at night. I listened. Nothing.
poi.universe.log.situation.5: The comm array only picks up static. %1$s has realigned the antenna thirty times; the signal hasn't changed.
poi.universe.log.situation.6: The temperature swings get worse every day and our suit protection won't hold for long. %1$s has started coughing.
poi.universe.log.situation.7: We found a stone covered in symbols on the northern ridge. %1$s took pictures and says it can't be natural.
poi.universe.log.situation.8: Found a new creature today. %1$s gave it an awful name and logged it in the discovery log anyway.
poi.universe.lore.1.text: Traveler, you can hear us. Long ago we too set out from one small world, looked up at the sky, and believed the stars would never go dark.
poi.universe.lore.1.title: Echo
poi.universe.lore.10.text: At the heart of the cluster is something that swallows light. Our last fleet flew toward it. Some called it escape. Some called it going home.
poi.universe.lore.10.title: The Center
poi.universe.lore.11.text: You will build your rings and your shells too. We will not stop you; we cannot. We only want you to know what they cost.
poi.universe.lore.11.title: Choice
poi.universe.lore.12.text: If one day your sky begins to dim, remember to come back here and lay your hand on the stone. We will hear you.
poi.universe.lore.12.title: Last Words
poi.universe.lore.2.text: We learned to tame stars. The day the first ring closed around our sun, our nights were never dark again. We had more energy than we could ever use, so we went looking for more stars.
poi.universe.lore.2.title: The First Ring
poi.universe.lore.3.text: A thousand stars wrapped in our shells. Light flowed along the roads we laid, from one system to the next. We called it prosperity.
poi.universe.lore.3.title: The Web of Stars
poi.universe.lore.4.text: We hollowed out world after world. Forests became pits, oceans became coolant pools. Planets do not protest, so we heard nothing.
poi.universe.lore.4.title: Quiet Worlds
poi.universe.lore.5.text: Later we built the Sentinels to watch over the worlds that remained. They know no masters, only harm. The ones you meet today are their descendants.
poi.universe.lore.5.title: Sentinels
poi.universe.lore.6.text: We quarreled over the stars. Some wanted the shells torn down so starlight could reach the barren worlds again. Others said we still did not have nearly enough.
poi.universe.lore.6.title: Fracture
poi.universe.lore.7.text: The farthest systems began to dim, one after another. They were not dying; they were being enclosed. Someone among us was building in secret, and we never learned who.
poi.universe.lore.7.title: Dimming
poi.universe.lore.8.text: Then came the Silence. Every channel went quiet at once, as if someone had closed a door. We never understood what lay on the other side.
poi.universe.lore.8.title: The Silence
poi.universe.lore.9.text: Those who remained raised these monoliths. We carved our memories into stone, because stone outlives us. Part of the survey data in your hands came from us.
poi.universe.lore.9.title: Monoliths
poi.universe.response.1.text: You came back. Your star has dimmed a little; we felt it. We said we would hear you, and we have been listening all this time.
poi.universe.response.1.title: You Came Back
poi.universe.response.2.text: We enclosed too many stars. The light of the cluster began to flow toward one place, the center. It swallowed every channel. That was the Silence.
poi.universe.response.2.title: Where the Silence Came From
poi.universe.response.3.text: The center feeds on the energy we gathered. The more we gathered, the faster it grew. Half the systems that went dark were eaten by it.
poi.universe.response.3.title: The Center
poi.universe.response.4.text: Our last fleet flew in carrying every joule we had stored, to give it back. The fleet never returned, but from that day on the center stopped growing.
poi.universe.response.4.title: The Fleet
poi.universe.response.5.text: You call it the universe matrix. We called it the key. It weaves matter, energy and information together in a form the center can read. With it, energy can be taken, and it can be returned.
poi.universe.response.5.title: The Key
poi.universe.response.6.text: Finish your research. Then you will see that the shells were only a beginning. When you gather, remember to keep a share to give back.
poi.universe.response.6.title: A Last Request
story.universe.ending.2: The Universe Survey had two goals: map this cluster, and find a source of energy a civilization could live on indefinitely.
story.universe.ending.3: You did both. Every system you crossed and every species you named is in my records. You lit a star of your own and wrapped another in shells.
story.universe.ending.4: The Precursors walked this road before you. They enclosed a thousand stars, and then the Silence came. It only stopped when their last fleet gave the energy back to the center.
story.universe.ending.5: The universe matrix in your hands is the key they spoke of. The center can read us now.
story.universe.ending.6: How much you take from here, and how much you give back, is up to you. The monoliths will still be there.
story.universe.ending.7: I never heard from the other eleven probes again. I will keep sending my own signal until the battery runs out.
story.universe.ending.8: If someone finds me on some planet one day, tell them someone made it to the end.
story.universe.ending.skip: Hold Space to speed up, Esc to close
story.universe.ending.title: UNV-7 · Final Log
story.universe.log.first_shell: The first shell panel is complete. From here that star looks a little dimmer. The monoliths said it: when your sky begins to dim, go back and lay your hand on the stone.
story.universe.log.first_shell.title: UNV-7 · Shell
story.universe.log.first_space: You're out of the atmosphere and the signal is much clearer. The survey launched twelve probes. I'm the only one still transmitting.
story.universe.log.first_space.title: UNV-7 · Orbit
story.universe.log.first_universe_matrix: The first universe matrix is done. Its readings sit on the same frequency as the signal in the monoliths. I checked three times.
story.universe.log.first_warp: During the jump I lost your signal for four seconds. The other probes all sent their last position report right after a jump.
story.universe.log.first_warp.title: UNV-7 · Jump
